rule: Files listed below may retain parity, implementation-history or diagnostic value, but their timing numbers must not be used for kernel selection, speedup claims, regression thresholds or capacity planning.
invalidated_reason: They were measured before the 2026-09-23 reboot while the same machine showed approximately 2x degraded DiT and over 20x degraded VAE performance. Stable ABBA ratios within that state were not sufficient evidence of healthy performance.

invalid_local_measurements.reason: forced the 1024-oriented b4128/a4096 partition onto a 1056-row 512 workload; retained only as a route-mismatch diagnostic

screened_but_not_selected.reason: valid clean b1056 measurement, but the M4 Pro-oriented a8192 split is nonoptimal on M4 Max and loses to pure GPU
